original_title: Halo: Campaign Evolved to Get Firefight as a Free Update
summary_en: After launching as a campaign-only experience, **Halo: Campaign Evolved** is set to receive its first major multiplayer addition. The fan-favorite Firefight mode is coming as a free update, bringing cooperative PvE action back to the iconic shooter.

en.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Finally Adds Beloved Firefight Mode This Winter
en.summary: After launching as a campaign-only experience, **Halo: Campaign Evolved** is set to receive its first major multiplayer addition. The fan-favorite Firefight mode is coming as a free update, bringing cooperative PvE action back to the iconic shooter.
en.body:
For nearly two decades, Firefight has been a cornerstone of the *Halo* experience, challenging squads of Spartans to band together against relentless waves of alien threats. Now, this cherished mode is officially making its way to **Halo: Campaign Evolved**, the critically acclaimed remake that brought the original *Combat Evolved* campaign to modern platforms. This highly anticipated addition will arrive as a free update this winter, offering a substantial dose of cooperative PvE action for players eager to team up.

The initial launch of **Halo: Campaign Evolved** focused on a faithful revival of the original campaign, a move that garnered praise for its fidelity but left many fans yearning for more multiplayer options. The announcement of Firefight as a free update signals a significant expansion of the game's offerings, providing a robust cooperative experience that has been a series mainstay since its introduction in *Halo 3: ODST*.

## Firefight Returns to the Forefront

The four-player cooperative PvE mode tasks players with surviving increasingly difficult waves of enemies, testing their teamwork, strategy, and combat prowess. While the exact enemy compositions and map designs for this new iteration have yet to be fully detailed, the tradition of Firefight suggests an experience that will be both familiar and thrilling for long-time fans. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed the returning mode, teasing a graphic that showcased Spartans battling a formidable mix of Covenant and Flood forces. This update marks the first multiplayer mode to be added to **Halo: Campaign Evolved**, a game that was primarily envisioned as a celebration of the original campaign's legacy.

> "For nearly two decades, Firefight has been a Halo favorite, challenging Spartans to team up, hold the line, and survive wave after wave of enemies. The tradition continues this winter as we add the four-player cooperative PvE mode to Halo: Campaign Evolved in a free update."

## A Celebration for the Fans

The arrival of Firefight is perfectly timed with Xbox's ongoing 25th-anniversary celebrations, a milestone that *Halo* itself helped inaugurate. Attendees at the recent Xbox FanFest in Seattle were among the first to get hands-on with the new mode, experiencing it across fresh maps and with an arsenal designed to help them overcome the odds. This early access offers a glimpse into the developer's commitment to engaging the community and delivering on fan expectations. While arena-style competitive multiplayer was not part of the initial pitch for **Halo: Campaign Evolved**, the addition of Firefight could indeed be a promising indicator of future multiplayer content.

## What Comes Next

Further details about the Firefight update, including specific gameplay mechanics and additional content, are expected to be shared at **Halo Fest** on December 12-13 in Seattle, WA. This event will offer another opportunity for fans to experience the mode firsthand and learn more about what the future holds for **Halo: Campaign Evolved**.

content_raw: When Halo: Campaign Evolved first came out in July it did not include any multiplayer modes, but the first-person shooter remake will at least get Firefight as a free update this winter. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced the returning mode in a social media post Thursday, along with a graphic showing a team of Spartans shooting a mix of Covenant and Flood enemies with various guns. While Firefight isn't the arena competitive multiplayer that most fans had hoped from the Halo remake at launch, wave-based PvE has been a mainstay in the series since Halo 3: ODST in 2009. Essentially, you and your friends load into a map and fight increasingly difficult waves of enemies until you get overwhelmed. There's no reason to believe that this iteration is going to be any different. Regardless of whether or not Team Deathmatch comes to Halo: Campaign Evolved, this will be the first multiplayer mode to hit the remake, which was pitched primarily as a straight-up revival of the iconic Combat Evolved campaign. Multiplayer was the major piece missing from Campaign Evolved, and this could be a sign that more multiplayer modes will be added in the future. IGN's Halo: Combat Evolved remake gave it a 7 . We said: "Halo: Campaign Evolved speaks to the series' timelessness and adds a decent set of new missions, but it's a mostly a lean retread that's more of a test run for its future with Unreal Engine." This Firefight announcement comes as Xbox celebrates its 25th anniversary. Earlier today, Sharma looked ahead, predicting "a single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations." As for Halo, following the summer's drastic cuts at Microsoft's gaming business, Xbox announced a significant reshuffle that saw the next mainline Halo game handed to Call of Duty developer Activision , which is spinning up a new team to work on the franchise. Mass layoffs hit Halo Studios at the same time.
